text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway
on my way back to the Trainer's office――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Individuality, individuality... Mmm.
I've thought about it so much, I don't even know anymore~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That thing about wanting to get some individuality?
You're still going on about that?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Because... if I'm just "ordinary,"
no one's really gonna remember me~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ordinary, huh... Well, when people talk about
having a distinct personality, they usually mean that, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan had a realization.
Slides are way cooler than stairs in this day and age!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right, let the DIY commenceeee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... Now that's what I call individuality!!
I gotta take notes!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What are you even saying, girl?!
I didn't mean you should actually use her as a reference!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look closer! Air Groove-san is
chasing her down with a terrifying scowl, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ngh, that's just the power of true individuality...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no use. Her switch has been flipped.
...*sigh*, guess I've got no choice.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There's no way you could ever become
a prank king like Golshi-san anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you really want to take a page from her book,
why not just try being a little mischievous prankster?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pranks are bad, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the completely sensible reaction.
But weren't you the one wanting to take cues from Golshi-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Th-That's true. But playing pranks on
people or things just feels wrong...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then let's just get whoever's eavesdropping to help out.
...You don't mind, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! That's so kind of you...
Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by her momentum,
I ended up going along with Matikanetannhauser's prank――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, behold Matikanetannhauser!
Now, prepare to be pranked~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could you close your eyes please?
I'm about to draw doodles on your face...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Way to spoil the prank beforehand!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: A bit here, and... like that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... *snicker*, drawing eyes on eyelids is such
a classic, but... pffft, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew. All done, perfectly~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... that was hilarious. But man, you went
way too hard on the details. How many eyelashes did you draw on there?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The marker is water-based, so it'll come off easily~.
Still, let's go wash it off right away just in case.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your cooperation!
Does this make me a proper little prankster now~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. Totally.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait? Does doing it just once
really count as individuality??

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't, right? All I did was ask politely
and doodle on their face, after all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! I should've realized before doing it~!
Maybe I really am just completely ordinary after all?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I think that whole thing is
what makes 'Tannhauser's normal' so unique, though?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~! No matter what I do, I'm just me~?!
I'm still just ordinary~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No way~ and after I tried so hard, too...
*deflates*...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... You're already plenty
interesting just the way you are, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she can be a bit quirky and offbeat at times,
Matikanetannhauser always charges straight toward her goals.
